text:
For period 2026-Q2, the source records include adverse event reporting for READM-30 and CLABSI-01.

The READM-30 measure, identified as the 30-day all-cause readmission rate, was reported in percent. The record lists a numerator of 76, a denominator of 1033, and 33 exclusions. The reported rate for this measure was 7.6 percent. The event dates recorded for READM-30 were 2026-02-10, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-17, and 2026-12-02.

The CLABSI-01 measure, identified as the central line-associated bloodstream infection rate, was reported per 1,000 line-days. The record lists a numerator of 107, a denominator of 1242, and 66 exclusions. The reported rate for this measure was 90.99 per 1,000 line-days. The event dates recorded for CLABSI-01 were 2026-01-11, 2026-04-01, 2026-08-22, 2026-10-02, and 2026-11-03.

Together, these records document reported readmission and central line-associated bloodstream infection measures for 2026-Q2, including the measure identifiers, measure names, units, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, and event dates exactly as provided in the source data. No additional adverse event categories, patient-level details, outcome descriptions, causality assessments, severity classifications, or benchmark comparisons were included in the source records.

references.citation: T. Lindqvist et al., "Readmission prediction: a multicenter study," International Review of Fictitious Medicine, vol. 5, pp. 289-699, 2018, doi: 10.9999/synth.477924.
